# re-derived fresh for Ш5d on 2026-08-25 by SEVEN independent reference
# channels, in the `channel` column below. This is an independent
# re-derivation of the question already asked once in
# views over named-method call sites, dated before Ш5a-c). That file is NOT
# reproduced here — its rows describe what each call site ASSUMES about the
# name; this file describes WHERE the name (as constant, literal, or a
# generic mechanism that happens to key on it) actually shows up, walked by
# different means. The two disagree in scope by design: see DISAGREEMENT
# EXCLUDED BY TASK SCOPE: scripts/finding-gate-controls/** (another agent is
# working there) and .claude/worktrees/** (git-ignored, not part of this
# CHANNEL 1 — constant-symbol (31 rows). Every appearance of the SYMBOLS
#   Does NOT see: any site that holds the same value through `self::NAME` from
#   inside ComputedMetricRule itself (that symbol text never appears) — see
#   CHANNEL 3; any site that receives the value through a variable already
#   consumed downstream of ChannelDeclarationCompilerPass.php:171 - this channel
#   sees the injection site, not every consumer of the injected constructor
#   argument); any site keyed by RuleNameReader::read() over the tagged rule
#   CLASS rather than by this symbol name - see CHANNEL 6.
# CHANNEL 2 — literal-string (305 rows). Every appearance of the bare text
#   Does NOT see: `self::NAME`, `$ruleName`, or any other symbol/variable that
#   RESOLVES to the string at runtime without spelling it — see CHANNELS 1, 3,
#   4, 5, 6; a value assembled by concatenation where the literal appears
#   fragmented across expressions (none found, but the method cannot rule that
#   out); the string inside a compiled/serialized artifact this repository does
#   not track (e.g. a consumer's own cache).
#   Sub-classified in the `role` column by directory heuristic (test-literal,
#   doc-internal-other) plus a crude "is this a comment" heuristic (leading
#   `//`, `*`, `#`, or `/**`) for tests/ and src/. The heuristic is textual,
#   not semantic — it can misfile an edge case; none were found in a manual
#   skim of the src/ and constant-declaration rows (12 lines), which is the
#   only bucket where misfiling would matter for Ш5d.
# `ComputedMetricRule.php` itself: `getName()`'s return value and the profiler
# `ProfilerInterface::start()`). Found by reading the profiler wiring in
# ComputedMetricRule.php after noticing CHANNELS 1-2 return nothing for
# "profiler span name" despite the task naming that surface explicitly:
#   This is the channel that PROVES channels 1 and 2 alone miss real sites even
#   inside the file that DEFINES the constant, matching the task's warning that
#   a classification step without its own "how obtained" line is where past
#   Does NOT see: any other rule class's `self::NAME`/`static::NAME` (irrelevant
#   to computed.health by construction) or a hypothetical second span built
#   from a different expression (this was found by reading one file end to end,
#   not by a pattern general enough to catch a sibling case elsewhere).
# CHANNEL 4 — producer-resolution-call (23 rows). Call and declaration sites of
# producer's name (including computed.health) is resolved or looked up
# THROUGH at runtime, with no literal string or named constant at the call
#   Does NOT see: test call sites of the same two methods (tests/ was excluded
#   from this grep on purpose — CHANNELS 1-2 already carry the test rows that
#   pass 'computed.health' as the literal argument to these same methods, and
#   listing the call site twice under two channels would double the count
#   without adding information); any caller reached through an interface
#   variable typed only as `ChannelIdentityInterface` where the method name
#   itself is spelled differently at the call site (none found, by inspection
#   of the two interface's known implementors: ChannelUniverse is the only one
# CHANNEL 5 — rulename-field-read (9 rows). Every read of `Finding::$ruleName`
# in `src/Reporting/**` — the field every computed-family finding carries the
#   Policy/Baseline and Finding-execution reads are already covered by
#   CHANNELS 1, 2 and 4, which is why this channel is scoped to Reporting only
#   — widening it would recount those); a formatter that reads `$ruleName`
#   under a different local variable name without the literal `->ruleName`
#   `TextFormatter`, and SARIF's own per-result payload (as opposed to its
#   separate rule-descriptor collection, which IS in this channel) were checked
#   by hand and found to read `Finding::$code` only, never `$ruleName` — filed
#   below as `checked-no-dependency` (CHANNEL 7) so the absence is a recorded
# call sites: a generic mechanism that keys a map by whatever rule class it is
# given, with `ComputedMetricRule` one un-named member of that set — no literal
# string, no named constant, no method name mentioning "producer" at the site.
#   (Two `::getClasses()` hits from the same broader grep were manually
#   excluded: `Cycle::getClasses()` in CircularDependency is an unrelated
#   method on an unrelated type that happens to share a name.)
#   Does NOT see: a map built by iterating tagged services directly by
#   container tag rather than by calling this one reader function (none found,
#   but compiler passes that assemble maps without going through
#   `RuleNameReader` at all would be invisible to this grep — CHANNEL 1's
#   ChannelDeclarationCompilerPass:171 DI-argument injection is the boundary
# CHANNEL 7 — checked-no-dependency (5 rows). Places the task's own checklist
# names (SARIF/GitLab fingerprints, the baseline) that were checked by hand
# and found to carry NO dependency on the producer name at all, recorded so
# the absence reads as evidence, not omission:
#     off `$code` too; only the separate SarifRuleCollector rule-DESCRIPTOR
#   - qmx-baseline.json (all 178 subject keys, read directly with
#     `python3 -c "import json; ..."` and grepped for the literal): every entry
#     is `{channel, occurrence, count}` where `channel` is the bare code
#     (e.g. `health.cohesion`) — post-Ш5b's collapse of channel identity to
#     "code only" already removed the producer name from this artifact's data;
#     the DEPENDENCY that remains is CHANNEL 4's `producerOf()` calls in
#     which resolve the producer at explain/migrate time rather than storing it.
#   Not obtained by a single command — each is a targeted read, listed as its
#   own row with the command/method in its `snippet` field.
# The prior enumeration-producer-name-consumers.tsv counted 66 rows across
# (code/declaration sites only, excluding pure prose) sum to 31+3+23+9+11 = 77
# rows — MORE, not because the prior count was wrong (it counted distinct
# ASSUMPTIONS a call site makes, sometimes several per line, and deliberately
# excluded test files and doc prose), but because this re-derivation walks by
# SYMBOL and by LITERAL rather than by assumption, and lands on a different
# — overlapping, not identical — set of lines. The two are not directly
# diffable row-for-row; the fact that neither is a subset of the other is
# itself the finding the task asked this method to surface.
